name: roster
description: Your Claude Managed Agents sessions inside Claude Code: /roster opens a pane of running and recent sessions, and /roster-watch follows one as a background task.

antPath.title: ant CLI
antPath.description: The ant command to run: a name on your PATH or a full path. It must be logged in (ant auth login).

limit.title: Sessions to load
limit.description: How many of the newest sessions the pane loads on each refresh.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the open pane reloads the session list. 0 refreshes only on [r].

watchMinutes.title: Watch for (minutes)
watchMinutes.description: How long a watched session's background task runs before it stops. At most 30.
